name: Add Email Uniqueness Constraint
description: The users table in `app.py` allows duplicate email addresses because the schema has no UNIQUE constraint and `create_user` does not check for duplicates. Fix this by adding a UNIQUE constraint on the email column in the schema AND raising an appropriate exception when a duplicate email is attempted.
visible_hint: create_user('Alice', 'alice@example.com') should succeed and return a positive integer ID
